name: Pull Thread
description: Pull a thread of the foe's balance with one hand and strike with the other as they lurch.

name: Lucky Mantle
description: Draw a mantle of good fortune about the shoulders so that stray blows go wide of the mark.

name: Luck Step
description: Take the step that luck has left open and find the ground firm beneath it.

name: Weigh Odds
description: Weigh the likely result of two courses of action and feel which thread holds the heavier end.

name: Fair Chance
description: Tilt the odds of the user's next act toward a fair chance by smoothing the thread it hangs from.

name: Fate Twist
description: Twist the thread of the foe's footing as the blow lands so that they stumble into its full weight.

name: Ill Fortune
description: Lay a dark thread on one foe so that every small thing they try goes slightly wrong for as long as the user holds it.

name: Loaded Lot
description: Throw a blow weighted to fall on the foe's worst moment and not on their best.

name: Lot Screen
description: Hold a screen of dealt chances between the body and the foe's blade so that the worst lot never falls.

name: Lot Reading
description: Cast a handful of small tokens and read from how they fall which of two foes will move first.

name: Short Straw
description: Hand the foe the short end of the next chance so that their first strike misses by a hair.

name: Lot Step
description: Draw the safe lot and step to where it lands.

name: Weighted Draw
description: Weight the next draw of fortune toward the user and an ally within arm's reach.

name: Doom Lot
description: Strike with a blow that carries the worst lot in the foe's hand and lands on the weakest part of their body.

name: Lot Ward
description: Ward the body with a sturdy lot so that even a well-aimed blow is likelier to glance than to bite.

name: Fray Cut
description: Chop at the thread of the foe's guard where it is already worn thin.

name: Slack Thread
description: Let slack into the thread of an incoming blow so that it drifts past the body.

name: Loose End
description: Find the loose end of the foe's plan and learn from it which way they mean to move.

name: Snag Step
description: Step past a snag in the flow of the fight and slip through where the foe's guard has caught.

name: Frayed Grip
description: Fray the thread of the foe's grip as the strike lands so that their weapon turns and drops.

name: Unpick
description: Pick at the threads of one foe's intent until their stance and plan come apart in their hands.

name: Weighted Blow
description: Deliver a blow at the exact moment the odds say the guard will be lowest.

name: Warning Thread
description: Feel a rising likelihood of harm a breath ahead and know its direction.

name: Shaded Odds
description: Cast a shade across the odds of a clean hit so that blows struggle to find a vital place.

name: Likely Step
description: Step to the spot where the likeliest strike will not fall.

name: Odds Draw
description: Draw the likelier outcome toward the user's hands and let steadiness do the rest.

name: Chance Parry
description: Put up a parry that depends on the foe's blade being where it most often falls.

name: Long Odds
description: Thrust at a narrow chance that nobody would try and find that it was open all along.

name: Reckoning
description: Reckon the odds of a whole exchange from the first move to the last and mark which stroke decides it.

name: Misfortune Brush
description: Brush the foe's sleeve with a touch of misfortune so that their next two moves both misfire.
